newsitem.title: ITALY: Autogrill H1 1996 net profits rise. [CORRECTED 16:54 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Autogrill H1 1996 net profits rise. [CORRECTED 16:54 GMT]

text.p: NOTE - The Italian restaurant chain Finanziaria Autogrill said its net investment in the first half amounted to 57 billion lire compared to 77.4 billion lire in the whole of 1995. The group's liquid assets (corrects from net debt) at the end of the half year was 210.2 billion lire compared to 215.3 billion lire at end-1995 and 157.8 billion lire at end-June 1995.
The group said the average number of employees rose to 7,831, some 440 more than in the same period of 1995.
It added that group sales for the first half rose 3.7 percent, after stripping out the effects of price increases.
The group, which operates 461 restaurants in Italy and has restaurants in France and Spain, has been listed on the Milan bourse since January 1996.
Finanziaria Autogrill is controlled by Edizion Holding (the Benetton family company) with minority holdings held by Switzerland's Moevenpic Holding and Turin bank San Paolo.
